input.command:
cd /root/nlp_variance_gtheory && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && export PYTHONPATH=/root/nlp_variance_gtheory:$PYTHONPATH && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

df = pd.read_csv("results/design_matrix_exp001_full.csv")
gemma_fp32 = df[(df["model"] == "google/gemma-2-9b-it") & (df["precision"] == "float32")]
print(f"Gemma float32 conditions: {len(gemma_fp32)}")

out_dir = Path("results/exp001_gemma_fp32/shards")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

gemma_fp32 = gemma_fp32.sample(frac=1, random_state=42).reset_index(drop=True)
shard_size = len(gemma_fp32) // 4
for i in range(4):
    start = i * shard_size
    end = start + shard_size if i < 3 else len(gemma_fp32)
    shard = gemma_fp32.iloc[start:end]
    path = out_dir / f"shard_{i}.csv"
    shard.to_csv(path, index=False)
    print(f"shard_{i}: {len(shard)} conditions -> {path}")
PYEOF
